newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms in Hong Kong fear corruption--survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms in Hong Kong fear corruption--survey.

text.p: Japanese firms in Hong Kong fear the British colony's reversion to Chinese rule next week may trigger a rise in corruption cases, according to a survey by Jiji news agency released on Tuesday.

More than 60 percent of the respondents in Jiji's survey of 183 Japanese firms in Hong Kong, conducted earlier this month, said they also feared Chinese firms might receive preferential treatment at the expense of foreign firms.
More than two-thirds of the firms which responded to the survey predicted that China would keep its promise to guarantee the capitalist ways of Hong Kong for at least five years.
More than 90 percent said the reversion would have no effect on Hong Kong's social stability or continuing economic growth, the survey found.
